findings.evidence: Line 174 reads `/- The components of \`volumeFormRaise a b u\`: …`; lines 176, 185, 194, 203 declare the four theorems with no `/--` attached.
findings.fix: Make it a docstring (`/-- … -/`) on `volumeFormRaise_apply_inl`, or turn it into a `/-! ### … -/` section header covering the four lemmas and give each a one-line docstring naming the deleted row.
findings.issue: The comment describing the component lemmas opens with `/- ` rather than `/-- `, so `volumeFormRaise_apply_inl`, `volumeFormRaise_apply_inr_zero`, `volumeFormRaise_apply_inr_one` and `volumeFormRaise_apply_inr_two` are all public and undocumented.

findings.evidence: EpsilonEridani/Relativity/Tensors/RealTensor/Metrics/LeviCivita.lean:54-62: `/-- The rank-4 contravariant Levi-Civita symbol … -/ def leviCivita4UpInt … := - leviCivita4Int μ ν ρ σ`, with `leviCivita4Int = generalizedKroneckerDelta ![μ,ν,ρ,σ] id = leviCivitaSymbol`.
findings.fix: Either drop the "fixed in this repository" claim and state only the numerical relation (`volumeForm`'s covariant components equal the function `leviCivita4UpInt`, despite its name/docstring describing it as contravariant), or add one sentence noting that `Metrics/LeviCivita.lean` uses the opposite convention.
findings.issue: The module docstring claims `ε^{0123} = +1` is "the one fixed in this repository" and then says `volumeForm`'s (covariant) components are `realLorentzTensor.leviCivita4UpInt`. That declaration is documented in-repo as "the rank-4 contravariant Levi-Civita symbol" equal to `-leviCivitaSymbol`, i.e. it fixes ε^{0123} = −1 — the opposite convention and the opposite index placement for the same numbers. A reader following the cross-reference gets a contradiction with no flag.

findings.evidence: Lines 31-36 of the module docstring; `def transverseEps : BilinForm R V := ε.bilinMap ![L.nPlus, L.nMinus]` (line ~337) takes two vectors, hence is the covariant tensor; `transverseEpsLin`'s docstring correctly states `(E u)^μ = ε_{T ν}{}^{μ} u^ν`.
findings.fix: Write `ε_{T μν} = ε_{μνρσ} n₊^ρ n₋^σ` for `transverseEps` in the module docstring and in the def docstring at line 335, keeping the raised notation for `transverseEpsLin`. Same wording appears in `EpsilonEridani/Relativity/LightConeBasis.lean:35`.
findings.issue: `transverseEps` is denoted `ε_T^{μν} = ε^{μνρσ} n_{+ρ} n_{-σ}` (both indices up) while the very next sentence says "its second index can be raised" to get `transverseEpsLin`. The bilinear form `(u,v) ↦ ε(u,v,n₊,n₋)` is the all-lower tensor `ε_{Tμν} = ε_{μνρσ} n₊^ρ n₋^σ` (there is no metric at all in the `CommRing` section), so the two statements cannot both hold.

summary: Documentation is largely accurate and the sign conventions are spelled out, but four public component lemmas lost their docstring to a `/-` vs `/--` slip, the cross-reference to the in-repo `leviCivita4UpInt` asserts a repository-wide convention that the cited declaration documents the other way round, and the `transverseEps` docstrings label an all-lower bilinear form with two raised indices.
